authorization: The project owner authorized the digest-frozen aggregate-only offline readiness audit. No agentic falsification run, provider call, cohort selection, source rendering, store mutation, or lifecycle change was authorized or performed.

covered_contracts: snapshot-bound structural claims and independent verification

gates.name: authoritative-usage-accounting
gates.basis: Current paths persist per-attempt authoritative or explicitly unknown usage and latency, continuation linkage, and supported dated-cost calculation.

gates.name: protected-evaluation-cohort
gates.basis: The independently frozen terminal pre/post pair exists, but one pair is not a broad real-world cohort.

gates.name: baseline-comparison
gates.basis: No frozen current-falsifier-versus-agent protocol or completed comparison exists.

gates.name: recall-safety
gates.basis: Unresolved cases and abstentions remain represented, but protected evidence cannot yet bound recall regression.

gates.name: cohort-breakdown
gates.basis: Mechanism, language, and detector metadata exist, but protected subgroup sizes are inadequate.

gates.name: read-only-tools
gates.basis: Deterministic retrieval and bounded slicing exist, but an enforced configuration-driven agent allowlist and provenance contract do not.

gates.name: independent-verification
gates.basis: Snapshot-bound independent syntax verification exists, but its mechanism coverage is not adequate for an unfrozen proposed cohort.

decision.smallest_next_prerequisite: Separately authorize an offline implementation and independent negative-test qualification of a configuration-driven read-only agent tool allowlist with immutable-snapshot and per-tool provenance enforcement.
decision.why_this_is_first: It closes the concrete G06 design-only gap without provider use or cohort selection and creates the containment boundary required before any agent comparison can be responsibly specified.
